acceptance: No required CI job pulls from Docker Hub anonymously; images stay pinned by digest.
A required job run shows the mirrored pulls.
description: During this effort the core and sql-execution-evidence jobs repeatedly failed on Docker Hub/ECR toomanyrequests and needed reruns. ci.yml:606 pulls questdb/questdb:10.0.1 from Docker Hub anonymously. The ECR Postgres pull at ci.yml:1337 is covered by ci-sql-evidence-postgres-ecr-rate-limit-20261022 (#3382); nightly.yml already uses ghcr.io. Identify every anonymous Docker Hub pull in required jobs (including whatever core pulls) and mirror to ghcr.io/benchbox-dev or authenticate.
